text:
[IRET.7.9.1] **On left-activation (new token from left
parent):**
- Count matches in right alpha memory using join tests.
- If count == 0: propagate the token as-is downstream
  (the absence is "matched").
- If count > 0: do not propagate; record that this token
  is blocked by `count` facts.

idris.name: iret_7_7__next_of
idris.note: A NOT node passes the unblocked, unextended.

idris.name: iret_7_7__store
idris.note: A NOT node records the block count of each arrival.

idris.name: iret_7_7__wave
idris.note: On left-activation a NOT node counts, then passes only the unblocked.

idris.name: iret_7_9_1__blockers
idris.note: How many right facts block a token: the count of joining facts.

idris.name: iret_7_9_1__counts_of
idris.note: The counts after arrivals: a NOT node records theirs, a positive node keeps none.

idris.name: iret_7_9_1__pass
idris.note: The tokens a NOT node passes: those nothing blocks.

idris.name: iret_7_9_1__record
idris.note: Record the block count of each arriving token.

idris.name: iret_7_9_1__none_of_kind
idris.note: A prefix with zero blockers in the node's memory is joined by no fact of the node's kind that the alpha admits.

idris.name: iret_7_9_1__zero_of_none
idris.note: A prefix joined by no admitted fact of the kind has zero blockers.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__view_from_front
idris.note: EVERY TOKEN OF THE NETWORK'S RECOMPUTE from a front is a token of FireLoop's: at a positive node the joining fact is a fact of the kind passing the guard; at a NOT node zero blockers is the `no` pattern not blocking.

idris.name: Iret_7_9_1__clear
idris.note: A TOKEN'S PASSAGE through a chain from a prefix: at a positive node it grows by one fact the join admits; at a NOT node its prefix counts zero blockers -- the clause's count == 0.

idris.name: iret_7_7__through_clear
idris.note: Every token a chain passes came through it clear from some token of the front.

idris.name: iret_7_9_1__blockers_zero
idris.note: With zero blockers, no fact of the memory joins the prefix.

idris.name: iret_7_9_1__clear_rejects
idris.note: A clear passage rejects every live fact at each NOT node admitting it: the memory shows working memory, so the fact is among the candidates counted, and the count is zero.

idris.name: iret_7_9_1__length_zero_nil
idris.note: A list of length zero is empty.

idris.name: iret_7_9_1__blockers_remove_hit
idris.note: Removing a joining fact from a distinct memory drops one blocker.

idris.name: iret_7_9_1__blockers_remove_miss
idris.note: Removing a fact the token does not join leaves its blockers.

idris.name: iret_7_9_1__clear_prefix
idris.note: A token that passes clear from a prefix extends it: what a NOT node passes on left-activation.

idris.name: iret_7_7__wave_consistent
idris.note: LEFT-ACTIVATION KEEPS THE VIEW: a chain consistent with its front, given new arrivals not among it, is consistent with the front plus the arrivals after the wave -- every node stored them, every NOT node counted them, the terminal gained exactly the matches they complete.

idris.name: iret_7_9_1__blockers_hit
idris.note: A joining fact appended to the memory adds one blocker.

idris.name: iret_7_9_1__blockers_miss
idris.note: A fact the token does not join, appended to the memory, adds no blocker.

idris.name: iret_7_9_1__length_snoc
idris.note: Appending one grows a length by one.

idris.name: iret_7_9_1__pass_elem_fwd
idris.note: A front token nothing blocks is passed.

idris.name: iret_7_9_1__pass_elem_inv
idris.note: A passed token is a front token nothing blocks.

idris.name: iret_7_9_1__record_hit
idris.note: Recording arrivals gives each its blocker count, distinct or not.

idris.name: iret_7_9_1__record_miss
idris.note: Recording arrivals leaves the count of a token not among them.
